messages:
sam: FYI I'm seeing a cluster of 429s for a handful of customers starting ~06:15 UTC, right after the rate threshold changes went live. Customers reporting failed requests and sudden invoice delta.
omar: thanks, digging in now. which customers? any repro links?
linda: alerted by anomaly detector at 06:18, saw 5xxs -> 429s pattern on edges in us-west1. Not a full outage but elevated errors and retries.
sam: affected: acme-inc, studio-zen, and two smaller orgs. acme sent example curl response.
sam: ```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: rq_7f2a3b
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
Retry-After: 30
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "detail": "client quota exhausted: policy threshold=1000/min"
}
```
omar: thanks. looks like the new threshold tweak (policy v3) dropped per-minute soft cap for some API keys. I see the rollout flag toggled at 06:12 by deploy-bot. deploy-bot: rollout completed for policy:v3 on prod (rollout_id=rl_2026_03_17_06).
deploy-bot: `policy:v3` applied to 36% of traffic (selector: default-accounts, env: prod)
omar: interesting — the rollout was intended for non-enterprise tenants only but selector matched some legacy keys due to label mismatch.
ryan: billing is getting alerts: spike in retry charges and a handful of invoices show extra token usage from retries. we should pause billing adjustments until we confirm root cause.
linda: action plan: 1) stop the rollout or reduce percentage to 0%, 2) open throttling exemption for enterprise keys temporarily, 3) run a quick backfill to revert retry-counted usage if confirmed.
sam: can someone flip the rollout? we need a quick rollback so customers stop seeing 429s.
omar: I can flip the feature-flag for policy:v3. command: `infractl rollout cancel rl_2026_03_17_06` — will do in 60s unless objections.
support-bot: note: cancelling a rollout will not change persisted policy versions for already routed sessions; KV cache TTL may cause some in-flight sessions to still see new limits for ~2 min.
omar: cancelling now. running: `infractl rollout cancel rl_2026_03_17_06`
omar: done. API returns success, rollout state=cancelled.
linda: monitoring: edge 429s dropping in last 30s, errors per minute back to baseline. good.
sam: acme confirms fewer 429s, says requests now mostly succeed.
ryan: holding billing anomalies for review. if rollback confirmed, we'll draft crediting plan for affected customers — small list only.
omar: root cause summary: selector for rollout used label `tier=standard` but legacy enterprise keys lacked canonical label; matching logic used presence of a new feature-flag header, unintended overlap meant some enterprise keys were included. Fix: tighten selector matching and add negative match for `org:enterprise`.
linda: follow-ups: - postmortem with timeline + who flipped rollout - add preflight check to block selector matches that would affect keys with active SLA tags - add smoke test to verify a sample set of enterprise keys before rollouts
sam: repro steps for eng to replicate locally: 1) create key with missing `org` label 2) apply policy:v3 with selector `tier=standard` 3) run parallel requests at ~1200 RPM to see Remaining -> 0 and rapid 429s.
sam: sample repro curl loop: ```bash
for i in {1..1500}; do 
  curl -s -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-legacy" 
    "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' &
done
```
omar: thanks, will run in staging. can also add a unit test to ensure selectors respect `org` label when present.
linda: after-action: schedule a short maintenance to run a canary of the corrected selector against 2% traffic for 24h before re-enabling wider rollout. not reusing the earlier rollout_id; create a new rollout with explicit negative match.
sam: assigning owners: omar = rollout fix + test, linda = monitoring smoke + canary plan, ryan = billing review and credits proposal, sam = customer comms draft.
omar: I'll have a PR up in ~45m.
ryan: I'll freeze billing adjustments until postmortem complete.
sam: thanks all. once PR merged and canary ready, ping #support and I'll update customers. :thumbsup:
support-bot: incident recorded: INC-2026-03-17-47, severity: low-medium, related-to: rate-policy-rollout
omar: PR merged, canary scheduled for 2% on staging. will request prod canary window after smoke.
linda: closing the thread for now; will reopen if we see regression.
sam: closing on our side too. follow-up meeting in 2 hours to review postmortem notes.
